title: Three insertion behaviors
html:
A · Prepend

Charlie goes first.

B · Append

Charlie goes last.

C · Alphabetical

Charlie is inserted, then the list is sorted.
js: const initial=['Bravo','Delta']; const state={A:[...initial],B:[...initial],C:[...initial]}; const paint=k=>{root.querySelector(`[data-demo="${k}"] output`).textContent='['+state[k].join(', ')+']';}; ['A','B','C'].forEach(paint); root.addEventListener('click',e=>{const card=e.target.closest('[data-demo]');if(!card)return;const k=card.dataset.demo;if(e.target.matches('[data-reset]'))state[k]=[...initial];if(e.target.matches('[data-insert]')){if(k==='A')state[k]=['Charlie',...initial];if(k==='B')state[k]=[...initial,'Charlie'];if(k==='C')state[k]=[...initial,'Charlie'].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b));}paint(k);});
